name: Selfish Prince -Kingdom of Barbaroa-
source:
Selfish Prince Lesciel lives in the kingdom of Barbaroa. He tries various dangerous things like jumping from the tower via towel without taking in account feelings of his butler and ninja servants. When will he grow up already?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
任性的王子莱斯西尔生活在巴巴罗亚王国。他不顾管家和忍者侍从的感受，尝试各种危险举动，比如用毛巾从塔上跳下。他究竟什么时候才能长大？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
